reviews.text: Celina was so great! She's very knowledgeable about color and made my vision for my hair come true! (She's also a sweetheart and fun to talk to!)
Was checking out a new salon and so happy I found Aria at Alt. She listened to my goals and we worked together to create a fresh look that I was really happy with!

I had a wonderful experience at Alt Salon, the wash bowls are super comfortable and the staff are friendly. My hairdresser Karilyn, was super nice, and did a wonderful job on getting me to my dream hair.
